maintenance_led.reason: Capstone's aftermarket parts and long-term service agreements on its installed microturbine base are, to my knowledge, the larger revenue part, above new units.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private industrial, oil and gas, data center and commercial buyers of microturbines, through distributors; government is a minor buyer.

serial_acquirer.reason: It grows by selling its own microturbines, services and energy-as-a-service offerings through distributors, not by regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Microturbines supply prime and backup power to hospitals, data centers and wastewater plants; switching means downtime, re-engineering and loss of service-contract support.

notes: The maintenance-led answer rests on my recollection that parts and service exceed new equipment sales. The website text doesn't give the revenue split.
